signin.title: Your own map, shaped by you
signin.lead: Keep the places you love, and what you remember about each visit.
signin.devFailed: Couldn't sign in. Check the user id and try again.
signin.otherAccount: Sign in with a different Kakao account
signin.removed: Your data was removed from this device.
signin.removeKept: Your data was kept on this device: some changes hadn't reached the server, or it couldn't be checked.

notInvited.title: This map is invite-only for now
notInvited.body: Your Kakao account isn't on the guest list yet. Ask the person who runs this magomap to add you.

account.title: Account
account.unsyncedTitle: Some notes haven't reached the server yet
account.unsyncedBody_one: {{count}} change, like a note or link, is only on this phone. It's safe here and goes out automatically when you sign in again with this account.
account.unsyncedBody_other: {{count}} changes, like notes or links, are only on this phone. They're safe here and go out automatically when you sign in again with this account.
account.exportHint: A JSON file with your notes, links, lists and saved places, and the shared place details they use. Needs a connection.
account.exportFailed: The download didn’t work. Try again in a moment.
account.deleteBody: Your notes, links, own lists and saved places are removed from magomap's server and from this device. Kakao Map, your Kakao lists and your Kakao account aren't touched. This can't be undone.
account.failed: Couldn't reach the server. Try again when you're online.
account.rejectedNote_one: {{count}} change couldn't be saved on the server. It stays on this phone, and you can copy its text from the sync status.
account.rejectedNote_other: {{count}} changes couldn't be saved on the server. They stay on this phone, and you can copy their text from the sync status.
account.deleteUnsynced_one: {{count}} change on this phone hasn't been sent yet and will be lost too.
account.deleteUnsynced_other: {{count}} changes on this phone haven't been sent yet and will be lost too.
account.signOutOffline: You can sign out once you're online. Your notes are safe on this phone.
account.mapHint: Automatic uses Kakao Map in Korea and OpenStreetMap elsewhere.
account.mapKakaoUnavailable: Kakao Map isn't available right now, so the map shows OpenStreetMap.
account.removeData: Also remove my data from this device
account.removeDataKept: Your unsynced changes will stay on this device, so its data won't be removed.

about.title: About
about.mismatch: The app is older than the server. Update to get the latest.
about.differs: The app and the server are on different versions.

map.canvasHint: Arrow keys move the map, and + and - zoom. Right-click, long-press, or press Shift+F10 to save a place here.

kakaoMap.title: Sync from Kakao Map
kakaoMap.lead: Brings in your lists from Kakao Map in this browser. Your notes here never change.
kakaoMap.reading: Reading your lists from Kakao Map…
kakaoMap.nothingChanged: Everything was already up to date.
kakaoMap.offline: Syncing needs a connection. Your places and notes still work offline, and what you write saves when you're back online.
kakaoMap.missingDesktop: Syncing from Kakao Map needs the magomap extension in Chrome or Brave on this computer.
kakaoMap.missingPhone: Syncing from Kakao Map happens on a computer. Install the magomap extension in Chrome on your computer. The lists on this phone show what you last synced.
kakaoMap.accountTail: the Kakao Map account ending in {{idTail}}
kakaoMap.confirmNote: After this, only this account syncs into this magomap. To change it later, sync from the other account and switch to it.
kakaoMap.mismatchBody: Your magomap syncs from {{expected}}, but this browser is signed in to {{current}}. Sign in to yours, or switch to this account.
kakaoMap.mismatchBodyNoBound: This browser is signed in to {{current}}, not the one your magomap syncs from. Sign in to yours, or switch to this account.
kakaoMap.mismatchKeeps: Your notes and saved places stay. Lists that aren't in this Kakao Map account will show as “Removed from Kakao” after the sync.
kakaoMap.lastFailed: The last sync didn't finish. Nothing of yours was removed.
kakaoMap.interrupted: The last sync didn't finish. Nothing of yours was removed. Start the sync again.
kakaoMap.errSignedOut: Sign in to Kakao Map in this browser, then sync again.
kakaoMap.errUnavailable: Couldn't read Kakao Map right now, so nothing changed. Try again in a little while.
kakaoMap.errBusy: Kakao Map is already being read. Wait a moment, then try again.
kakaoMap.errTaken: This Kakao Map account already syncs into someone else's magomap, so nothing changed. Sign in to Kakao Map with your own account.
kakaoMap.errNotAllowed: Syncing from Kakao Map isn't turned on for your account yet. Ask the person who set up magomap to turn it on.
kakaoMap.errUnclear: Couldn't tell which Kakao Map account these lists belong to, so nothing changed. Try again, or sign in to Kakao Map again.
kakaoMap.errTooLarge: One of your lists is too big to sync, so nothing of yours was removed. Try again; if it keeps happening, tell the person who set up magomap.
kakaoMap.errOffline: The connection dropped. Nothing of yours was removed, so you can sync again when you're back online.
kakaoMap.errSignedOutMagomap: Your session ended. Sign in again, then sync.
kakaoMap.errOther: The sync stopped partway. Nothing of yours was removed. Try again.
